basic_details.job_title: Raigad District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Raigad District has announced 10 vacancies for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post under its 2026 recruitment, with offline applications to be submitted by hand to Tahsil Office Pen by 17 October 2026. The application process for these posts starts on 2 October 2026. Interested candidates can apply offline by submitting the application in the prescribed format with necessary documents to the specified office on or before the given last date. All applications must be completed and submitted in accordance with the guidelines provided in the official recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: Raigad District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) at a Glance
Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted by hand or through the required offline channel to the following office: Village Revenue Officers, Circle Officers, Gram Panchayats, Panchayat Samiti Pen, Tahsildar Pen, and Sub-Divisional Officer Pen Applicants must submit the application in the prescribed format along with necessary documents to Tahsil Office Pen during working hours (excluding public holidays) between 02/10/2026 and 17/10/2026.
